heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can the app stream live video?
items.answer: Yes. We can build live streaming and on-demand playback.

items.question: How do you handle content protection?
items.answer: We support secure delivery and DRM options where required.

items.question: Can the app work on TV and web too?
items.answer: Yes. We can extend your platform beyond mobile.

items.question: How long does media and entertainment app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
